title: Best Baby Carrier (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Products were selected if they appeared in at least two of the listed sources (consumerreports.org, babygearlab.com, drsensory.com, ergobaby.com). Rankings considered weight capacity, number of carrying positions, and overall comfort as described in the sources.
assumptions: No price information was used except where explicitly stated; all picks are assumed to be currently available.

verdict.line: Parents who want a carrier that grows from newborn to toddler should choose the Ergobaby Omni because it supports babies from 7 lb to 45 lb in four positions, according to DrParenting. The catch is it’s heavier and bulkier than some soft‑wrap options.
